subject: Security gone when using index.html instead of ui.R

messages.author: 976cd555ec13dfa0
messages.subject: Security gone when using index.html instead of ui.R
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have a few apps up & running with security in place (login + pwd) as per the tutorial working fine. Now, I have designed this new app, and this time I got rid off the ui.R and create the whole front-end using www/index.html. The apps work fines (apart from some quirks in googlevis calendar) but I noticed I don't get prompt for login + pwd anymore.

Is this something anyone else has come across before? and more importantly are there any solutions or workarounds?

Many thanks,

Alberto

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Security gone when using index.html instead of ui.R
parts:
Alberto,
It should definitely be prompting you for a password.  Is it possible that you were logged into the application already? Alternatively, is it possible that the app that you redeployed was not configured with authentication?  (ie. was the app copied to a different directory?)

If you wouldn't mind sharing a link with me privately we can try to take a look at it and see.
-Tareef
